verified_unicode_script_source.proper_use: Locale default-script selection, not demographic proof of script literacy or linguistic intelligibility.
no_cross_credit_rules: Gurmukhi pa cannot automatically count Shahmukhi/Arabic-script pa-PK readers.
Devanagari hi and Arabic-script ur are separate written-localization events.
A likely subtag's default region does not relocate a census cohort: Bengali's default bn-Beng-BD does not make this Indian Bengali cohort Bangladeshi.
Bhojpuri/Rajasthani/Magahi/Chhattisgarhi defaulting to Devanagari does not show that a standard Hindi pack covers those cohorts.

cohort_audit.note: Mutual exclusivity follows the single mother-tongue classification and exact-leaf selection, conditional on verifying the original rows. Population membership in an all-age mother-tongue cohort does not establish comprehension: the census instructions also assign infants the mother's language.

using_new_official_population_denominato.answer_zh: 可以用同一官方人口修订版及同一日期的全球/地区人口统一分母，改善地理和年代口径；但这不能单独解决 2011 年语言分子的现年下界。

recommended_primary_denominator.required_freeze: One revision, one chosen date and variant, country/area age denominators plus the matching world denominator

stationary_share_scenario.formula: estimated_covered_IN_y = P_IN_y * (sum selected C16 leaves / P_IN_2011)
stationary_share_scenario.allowed_label: Historical-share scenario, conditional on unchanged language composition
stationary_share_scenario.not_allowed_label: Observed or proved conservative lower bound for current unique people
stationary_share_scenario.why: Births, deaths, migration, language change and language-specific age structure can change the selected share; a current total population alone places no useful positive lower bound on the selected share.

counterexample_not_real_population_data.lesson: The same later total supports 25% coverage in this example, while multiplying the old 50% share claims 50%. Updating the denominator is not a conservatism guarantee.

defensible_current_estimate_paths: Obtain a recent, nationally representative language or language/script reading survey with matching age/territory denominators and a defensible one-sided uncertainty bound.

Use C16 exact leaves as historical priors, explicitly model demographic change by language with published data, and report sensitivity/uncertainty rather than calling the unadjusted ratio a guaranteed current lower bound.

A strict old-cohort survivor approach needs an actually qualified earlier numerator and upper bounds on deaths, out-migration and loss of qualifying ability; newborn/new-language additions receive no credit without evidence. It cannot be derived from the current population total alone.
Reconcile country/area geographies before summation, including CLDR special territories. A migrant may not be counted once in a surviving-origin cohort and again in a current-destination survey.
using_new_official_population_denominato.demographic_survivor_bound_formula: A_current >= max(0, A_earlier - upper_bound(deaths among A) - upper_bound(out-migration among A) - upper_bound(loss of qualifying ability among A)), conditional on a stable definition and disjoint resident cohorts
using_new_official_population_denominato.survivor_formula_not_computed: No required death/migration/ability-loss bounds or qualified historical written-reading numerator were obtained. Mother-tongue labels alone do not qualify as that numerator.
using_new_official_population_denominato.reading_and_script_rule: Where only same-population spoken ability a and language-specific reading ability b are known, their intersection lower bound is max(0,a+b-1), not a*b without an independence assumption. Generic literacy or the CLDR default script is insufficient.
using_new_official_population_denominato.historical_model_warning: The prior 81.01951537477622% calculation remains a conditional language-reach planning scenario on the original CLDR population sum. This supplement does not turn it into a reading metric, harmonize its years, or establish a 2026 world-person bound.

steps_needed_to_finish_official_workbook: Download the public official XLSX with ordinary certificate checks when connectivity/tool access is available. Save exact source bytes only under tmp/coverage-research and record SHA-256 and response metadata.

Load with bundled Python openpyxl read_only=True, data_only=True, or equivalent lightweight extraction. Inspect actual worksheet/header layout before choosing columns; do not assume machine codes or cell addresses.

Select national India, total residence and persons exactly once. Separate uppercase language totals from named mother-tongue leaves; retain official leaf codes, sheet and coordinates alongside each cohort.

Reconcile selected fine leaves to the parent group without adding both levels. Check the complete national leaves/Other categories against the published 2011 denominator and verify persons = male + female where present.
Compare all 18 candidate values to their source cells; keep failures or ambiguous matches ineligible. Retain Census 2011 as the observation year even if the catalog/workbook was published later.
Keep numeric cohort validation, script-default verification, population reading eligibility and locale release review as separate statuses; passing one does not pass the others.
